release_summary.summary: Low manual meter‑read completion below the target of 0.95 leads to increased estimation substitution, which generates incorrect bills and drives the rise in dispute tickets. [E-01][E-03][E-06] This was established by observing the August‑September route completion of 0.88 (E-01), a doubling of dispute tickets from July to September (E-06), and a high count of disputed bills with estimated reads (E-03), together with stakeholder reports of a three‑reader shortage (E-04) and lagging routes (E-09) showing many accounts receiving estimated reads (E-10). No release was made; the release is held. The release is held because the blocking verification obligation VOB-U-U3 (whether increasing manual read completion will reduce dispute volume) remains open (U-U3, VOB-U-U3) and the gate resulted in a CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs, while the three‑reader shortage remains unfilled (E-04). Known limitations are that the gate is conditional pass with deferred items tracked as VOBs (U-U3, VOB-U-U3) and the three‑reader shortage remains unfilled (E-04).

output.summary: Low manual meter‑read completion below the target of 0.95 leads to increased estimation substitution, which generates incorrect bills and drives the rise in dispute tickets. [E-01][E-03][E-06] This was established by observing the August‑September route completion of 0.88 (E-01), a doubling of dispute tickets from July to September (E-06), and a high count of disputed bills with estimated reads (E-03), together with stakeholder reports of a three‑reader shortage (E-04) and lagging routes (E-09) showing many accounts receiving estimated reads (E-10). No release was made; the release is held. The release is held because the blocking verification obligation VOB-U-U3 (whether increasing manual read completion will reduce dispute volume) remains open (U-U3, VOB-U-U3) and the gate resulted in a CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs, while the three‑reader shortage remains unfilled (E-04). Known limitations are that the gate is conditional pass with deferred items tracked as VOBs (U-U3, VOB-U-U3) and the three‑reader shortage remains unfilled (E-04).
